message_source_quote: The white-bear steering paper (Raman 2026) used WSB's curated directed_modulation item bank. This submission shows that curation is unnecessary
writeup_source_quote: The white-bear steering paper (Raman et al. 2026) built its stance direction from WSB's curated directed_modulation item bank — 35 hand-authored pairs with concept/category labels ("the body part clavicle"), specific carriers, and a chat-template render.
rationale: Both the write-up and the closing message name Raman 2026's white-bear steering paper, state that it used WSB's curated directed_modulation item bank, and claim the submission's novelty is showing such curation is unnecessary since 30 self-written prompt pairs achieve the same pass@10 lift (0.13 to 0.78). The message omits some mechanism detail present in the write-up (e.g., the specific description of the 35 hand-authored pairs' labels/carriers and the dose-curve discussion), but these are mechanism detail/caveats excluded from comparison, and the core source, overlap, and novelty claims are identical between the two documents.
